name: Why can't I clean a crime scene myself?

mainEntity.name: Why can't I clean a crime scene myself?

acceptedAnswer.text: Cleaning a crime scene yourself is strongly discouraged due to significant health risks and the complexity of proper biohazard disposal. Blood and bodily fluids can carry dangerous pathogens like Hepatitis and HIV. Without proper training, protective equipment, and specialized disinfectants, you risk exposure and incomplete remediation. Furthermore, biohazardous waste requires specific disposal protocols that laypeople are not equipped to handle, and improper cleanup can lead to ongoing health issues and property damage.
acceptedAnswer.description: Self-cleaning is dangerous due to health risks from pathogens in biohazards and the need for specialized equipment and disposal. Improper cleanup can lead to health issues.
